text:
The parrot is the bird known for its ability to repeat what you say.

Alternative Ending: Instead of a confrontation at the Louvre, Margo tracks The Phantom to a secluded aviary in the countryside, where he has been hiding among rare birds. When she finally corners him, he does not reveal himself as her brother. Instead, he hands her a forged masterpiece and vanishes into the mist, leaving Margo to realize that the true mystery was never about catching him, but about understanding why he chose art over family. The case remains open, but Margo finds a strange peace in the chase, knowing that some secrets are better left unsolved.
